game_concept: A action defense set in Coastal Port – Island Ferry, the island ferry landing: the sailor must handle kraken tentacles while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Signal Logic: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings.
theme: Coastal Port – Island Ferry: the island ferry landing
core_gameplay_loop: In Island Ferry, repeat each round: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings. Each round, kraken tentacles strike the ferry, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the safety value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the ferry from kraken tentacles in Island Ferry: keep the safety meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: safety drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 9 (extended tier): Signal Logic
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Signal Logic' (Week 3 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Island Ferry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against kraken tentacles in Island Ferry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 76 seconds while safety > 0.
